$schema_note: Assistant tool registry definition. READ tools are executed server-side by the AI service against the backend API using the asking user's forwarded JWT. CONFIRM actions are NEVER executed by the AI service - they are emitted as confirm_action events; the client app executes the call only after the user taps Confirm. Anything not listed here is forbidden (guidance only).

read_tools.name: get_notices
read_tools.description: List the user's GST notices with optional filters.

read_tools.name: get_notice
read_tools.description: Get one notice's details (type, status, deadline, amounts, assignee).

read_tools.name: get_notice_report
read_tools.description: Get the AI analysis report of a notice (risk, summaries, action items). May return 402 if the plan lacks ai_explanation.

read_tools.name: get_notice_statistics
read_tools.description: Counts of notices by status/priority and due-soon/overdue totals.

read_tools.name: get_upcoming_deadlines
read_tools.description: Notices with deadlines coming up, soonest first.

read_tools.name: get_my_tasks
read_tools.description: The user's open tasks, optionally due within a window.

read_tools.name: get_subscription_usage
read_tools.description: Current plan, trial status, and usage against limits (notices, seats, GSTINs, storage).

read_tools.name: get_members
read_tools.description: Members of the current organization (names, roles, status). Requires a role that can view members.

params.orgId: uuid (injected from context, never from the model)

confirm_actions.description: Generate an AI draft reply for a notice. Requires draft_reply feature.
Create a task on a notice.
Add a custom reminder on a notice.
Move a notice to a new status (workflow-valid transitions only).

forbidden_note: Never tools: deletes of any kind, billing/payments, invitations or member/role changes, response approve/reject/mark-submitted, organization or GSTIN changes, admin portal, anything on the government GST portal.
